title: Hammerhead 6-Amp 4-1/2 Inch Angle Grinder with 3 pcs Grinding Wheel – HAAG060
description:

reviews_5s:
extremely powerful. Ran this sucker all day long cutting off old rusty parts from the underside of my truck. She didn't even feel like she was overheating at all. Impressive considering the price point. The only complaint I can think of is the holder for the chuck broke off the first time i took the chuck in and out of the handle. No big deal, nothing a small piece of duct tape won't fix, but it is definitely a design the manufacturer needs to rethink a bit. You can easily take off the safety guard if need be, although I advise caution: this little puppy is strong enough that if it gets caught it will jerk itself right out of your hands if you aren't ready. I think this thing is probably going to be the last one I ever have to buy, assuming it doesn't get stolen by the neighborhood crackheads, and assuming I don't forget to put it away and back the truck over it one of these days. If you're looking for a good corded grinder thats going to do the job for you and last a while, i think this one is the answer. Going to go see if this manufacturer makes any other tools right now.Got this in yesterday, so I haven't had the opportunity to plug this thing in and grind some stuff. Therefore, the star rating may change.

In the meantime, I'll give it 5 stars. It was packaged well, and everything sas in the box. It seems to be very well built, no plastic visible, except for the buttons and lever. The moveable handle is also a plastic, but of the durable type. Heavier than I expected. No obvious manufacturing flaws. For the price, I was expecting an obvious piece of junkI use this thing almost every day and I put it through its paces and another thing I like about it it's got the locking tool that you tuck into the handlethink im gunna order a couple more of these. i was skeptical due to the price but this thing is a beast. id say better quality than even the harbor freight ones, plus it has the convenience of the key being inside the handle for easy chuckingWorks well.Purchased this as a gift for my son, says it works great!Does the work. reviews_1s:
Ordered with one-day shipping for an immediate need. Grinder showed up and didn't work at all. Tried seller/manufacturer support and they entered everything in warranty, said to discard the old one and that replacement would arrive in a couple days.... 10 days later and still no sign of a grinder. Well, no sign of an "operable" one.
UPDATE: Called them back and they had forgot to elevate the issue. Ended up returning through Amazon. Thankfully hadn't already discarded broken one.Nope. After grinding away one bolt head on my car, it's making a slight rattle. The wheel feels firm, but there is a rattle you can hear as the blade is winding down. Probably not safe. Will return.This grinder is pure junk. You get what you pay for . The handle area of the grinder snapped off in the first ten iminutes and cost me a hospital ER visit. Spend the money on a quality grinder.Used for many months and loved it but during use the power became stuck on. Could not get it to turn off. Had to unplug it. Something internal must be awry. Serious safety hazard.Missing the hardware required to attach grinding wheel. Buy elsewhere or better yet local. $20 paper weightI bought two of these a month ago. I really like the grinder, with its easy-to-use paddle switch, in-handle tool storage, and light weight, but one of them has already died on me. The bearing at the rear of the motor exploded. It seems like there was very little, if any grease in it. The bearing seems to be pressed onto the shaft, so there is no easy way to replace it (I have replaced bearings in other grinders to get them going again).

So disappointing, because this is a great grinder overall. I may update the rating if the other grinder lasts.

Also, the grinding wheels that they come with them are horribly off balance. I used one for a few seconds and it was hand-numbing. I don't think that was the grinder that the bearing failed in, though an off-balance wheel could certainly lead to early bearing failures.I received this and within a week the drive gear stripped and it started making a high pitched sound whenever it slipped. That only got louder and more frequent till it couldn't even start since torque to get it moving was too much for the cheap gear to handle. I held on to it yo take it apart to figure out exactly where this failed and it's the drive gear that meets head gear. Looks like pinion perpendicular drive gear. But I don't know what these are made of but they are not durable in any way.Stopped working after a month :(WELL: this was to replace a cheapie $20.00 unit from Harbor Freight, that I bought in 2001. The gear head was getting VERY NOISY, so I was kind of afraid of it. This new one lasted for about 30 minutes. It would NO longer turn on. The paddle switch felt like it was NOT actuating the internal switch.DO not risk your safety. This is a very cheap product
